limitations: Causal interpretation is local to the declared prompts, observable, model revision, and doses.
Generated behavior is evidence only when generation was enabled and evaluated separately.
Supported status requires at least three random-control draws and a non-zero directional bootstrap interval; it is not a population-level significance test.
claims.statement: The ablate sweep measured selected-neuron effects against same-layer matched-random controls.

headline: Controlled FFN intervention evidence
key_results: Tested 20 ranked neurons with ablate over 6 split/condition/dose summaries.
Largest selected-minus-random absolute effect was +4.41477 at N=20, strength=0, split=discovery, condition=perturbed.
recommended_next_steps: Replicate the controlled effect on held-out perturbations.
Inspect collateral observables and additivity before assigning a narrow circuit claim.
